<!--
  Home-page corkboard markup (head). Wraps the listing — closing </div>
  is in corkboard-tail.qmd. Styled by dragon_theme/partials/_home.scss.
-->

````{=html}
<div class="oc-home">
<section class="oc-hero">
  <div class="oc-hero-kicker">Field notes on machine learning</div>
  <h1 class="oc-hero-title">The <em>Overfitting</em> Club</h1>
  <div class="oc-hero-row">
    <p class="oc-hero-lede">
      Tutorials you can actually run, paper walk-throughs, and occasional
      op-eds about the industry. Written in the margins by
      <span class="name">Miguel Chitiva Diaz</span> &mdash; with
      <em>calm, drama-free MLOps</em>.
    </p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="oc-corkboard">
  <div class="oc-corkboard-head">
    <div class="oc-kicker" id="oc-corkboard-kicker">&sect; The Corkboard</div>
    <h2 class="oc-corkboard-title" id="oc-corkboard-title">Pinned to the <em>corkboard</em></h2>
    <div class="oc-corkboard-caption" id="oc-corkboard-caption">Drafts, experiments, half-thoughts. Filter by section, or by tag within.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="oc-tape-filter">
    <div class="oc-tape-tabs" role="tablist">
      <button class="oc-tape-tab is-active" type="button" data-section="all" data-tape="old-white" role="tab" aria-selected="true">
        <span class="oc-tape-strip" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="oc-tape-label">All</span>
        <span class="oc-tape-count">0 entries</span>
      </button>
      <button class="oc-tape-tab" type="button" data-section="thoughts" data-tape="yellow" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <span class="oc-tape-strip" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="oc-tape-label">Thoughts</span>
        <span class="oc-tape-count">0 entries</span>
      </button>
      <button class="oc-tape-tab" type="button" data-section="tutorials" data-tape="green" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <span class="oc-tape-strip" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="oc-tape-label">Tutorials</span>
        <span class="oc-tape-count">0 entries</span>
      </button>
      <button class="oc-tape-tab" type="button" data-section="papers" data-tape="red" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
        <span class="oc-tape-strip" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="oc-tape-label">Papers</span>
        <span class="oc-tape-count">0 entries</span>
      </button>
      <div class="oc-tape-spacer"></div>
      <button class="oc-tape-clear" type="button" id="oc-tape-clear" hidden>&#x2715; clear filters</button>
    </div>
    <div class="oc-tape-tags" id="oc-tape-tags" hidden>
      <span class="oc-tape-tags-label">filter by tag &mdash;</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="oc-empty-state" id="oc-empty-state" hidden>
    <div class="oc-empty-mark">nothing here yet &mdash;</div>
    <div class="oc-empty-body">No posts match this combination. Try a different tag, or clear the filter.</div>
    <button class="oc-empty-clear" type="button">Clear filters</button>
  </div>
</section>
````
